title: Malicious code in youseethemoney (npm)
description: The npm package 'youseethemoney' version 1.0.1 contains malicious code hidden behind a decoy main entry. While the main entry is a benign Hello-World index.html, the package also includes a loader.html that fetches and executes JavaScript from a remote GitHub account via jsdelivr CDN mirrors. This remote code can be changed at any time by the attacker, leading to arbitrary code execution in any environment rendering loader.html, such as Chrome new-tab pages or HTML-based browser extensions using this package.
